definitions.explanation: The opposite side from the front; the hidden or less visible side of something.
The hidden aspects or background of a situation; what goes on out of public view.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏側|うらがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name on the back of the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏側|うらがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a parking lot behind the building.
The reverse side of the fabric is a different color.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏側|うらがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are complicated circumstances behind this incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{華|はな}やかな→華やかな：18036_hanayakana⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏側|うらがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}りたい→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I want to know what goes on behind the glamorous world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏側|うらがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Behind success lies years of effort.

notes:
{裏側|うらがわ} combines ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back, reverse) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏側|うらがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (on the back side of ~)
- {裏側|うらがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see the reverse side)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{表側|おもてがわ}→表側：25112_omotegawa⟧ (front side) - antonym
- ⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧ (right side)
- ⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧ (left side)
- ⟦{向|む}こう{側|がわ}→向こう側：08504_mukougawa⟧ (the other side)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏側|うらがわ}: back side, reverse
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: back (simpler form)
- ⟦{背面|はいめん}→背面：20610_haimen⟧: back surface (more formal/technical)
